content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect assignment of power domains for the Audio-DMAC and sound device nodes in the device tree source (DTS) file. Initially, both nodes were assigned to the `<&cpg_clocks>` power domain, which did not reflect the intended power management configuration. This led to inconsistent device power management, as these components should be part of the SYSC "always-on" power domain to ensure they remain powered on during operation. The patch corrects this by updating the power domain assignments to `<&sysc R8A7794_PD_ALWAYS_ON>`, ensuring proper functionality and power management for the audio components.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect assignment of power domains for the Audio-DMAC and sound device nodes in the device tree source (DTS) file. Initially, both nodes were assigned to the `<&cpg_clocks>` power domain, which did not reflect the intended power management configuration. This led to inconsistent device power management, as these components should be part of the SYSC "always-on" power domain to ensure they remain powered on during operation. The patch corrects this by updating the power domain assignments to `<&sysc R8A7794_PD_ALWAYS_ON>`, ensuring proper functionality and power management for the audio components.
Patch:
From 24b2d930a50662c11918fd0c22931f1448488da4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Date: Mon, 7 Nov 2016 20:10:04 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] ARM: dts: r8a7794: Use SYSC "always-on" PM Domain for sound

Hook up the Audio-DMAC and sound device nodes to the SYSC "always-on" PM
Domain, for a more consistent device-power-area description in DT.

Cfr. commit 0761ff2ad0c581f3 ("ARM: dts: r8a7794: Add SYSC PM Domains").

Fixes: 320d6c5a08a4abd3 ("ARM: dts: r8a7794: add sound support")
Fixes: 298e4ee3d213a076 ("ARM: dts: r8a7794: add Audio-DMAC support")
Signed-off-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Signed-off-by: Simon Horman <horms+renesas@verge.net.au>
---
 arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7794.dtsi | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7794.dtsi b/arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7794.dtsi
index 7d9f0601d3ca..364b4aa8d1c1 100644
--- a/arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7794.dtsi
+++ b/arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7794.dtsi
@@ -319,7 +319,7 @@ GIC_SPI 331 IRQ_TYPE_LEVEL_HIGH
 				  "ch12";
 		clocks = <&mstp5_clks R8A7794_CLK_AUDIO_DMAC0>;
 		clock-names = "fck";
-		power-domains = <&cpg_clocks>;
+		power-domains = <&sysc R8A7794_PD_ALWAYS_ON>;
 		#dma-cells = <1>;
 		dma-channels = <13>;
 	};
@@ -1485,7 +1485,7 @@ rcar_sound: sound@ec500000 {
 			      "mix.0", "mix.1",
 			      "dvc.0", "dvc.1",
 			      "clk_a", "clk_b", "clk_c", "clk_i";
-		power-domains = <&cpg_clocks>;
+		power-domains = <&sysc R8A7794_PD_ALWAYS_ON>;
 
 		status = "disabled";
 
--
